description:

**Job description**
-------------------


Requisition ID: 1744229
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  



EndPoint Infrastructure Patching \& Vulnerability Management Administrator


**Role Title**


EndPoint Infrastructure Patching \& Vulnerability Management Administrator

  

**Function / Portfolio**

Digital Workplace Enablement Services (DWES) – EndPoint Management

  

**Scope**



Patching \& vulnerability remediation of the \~450 on\-prem SCCM/APPPROXY infrastructure servers (CAS, Primary Sites, SQL site databases and supporting server roles)

  



**Job Description Summary**



Maintain and secure the Endpoint Management infrastructure (approximately 450 SCCM and AppProxy servers) by ensuring systems remain patched, hardened, and free of known vulnerabilities. Own the end\-to\-end server patching and remediation lifecycle, including monitoring, validation, deployment coordination, post\-patch verification, and driving vulnerability findings to closure.



The successful candidate will operate the patching lifecycle end to end: monitoring for released fixes, validating them, sequencing and executing patching in coordination with the SCCM and Approxy engineering team, restarting/validating servers, and driving vulnerability findings to closure.



The estate is split across non\-production and production environments and includes the Central Administration Site (CAS), Primary Sites and their SQL site databases, which are the true single point of failure for a site. Work is executed against an accelerated cadence and, when required, under an Emergency/Zero\-Day change model. The role is hands\-on, evidence\-driven and governed by EY change management (RFC / eCAB).

  

**Key Responsibilities**



**Server Patching \& Maintenance**


* Execute monthly, accelerated and emergency patching across the \~450 SCCM/AppProxy servers (non\-production first, then production), following the confirmed environment sequence.
* Sequence patching correctly so Windows/SQL work completes before SCCM/APPPROXY patching in each environment; perform and validate server restarts within the agreed windows.
* Apply Microsoft SCCM/APPPROXY hotfixes and SQL Server cumulative updates (CU/GDR) as prerequisites for a healthy SCCM/APPPROXY platform, coordinating carefully around SQL site databases to avoid taking a whole site down.
* Support High\-Availability failover patching (patch passive node/SQL replica, switch active/passive, patch former active) to minimize outage windows.

  


**Vulnerability Management \& Remediation**


* Own the remediation of vulnerabilities flagged against the SCCM/APPPROXY server estate (e.g. GVM / scanner findings from tools such as Qualys / Tenable), tracking each item to closure within SLA.
* Triage and prioritize findings by criticality (CVSS), separating in\-scope SCCM/APPPROXY/SQL items from those owned by other teams and re\-assigning out\-of\-scope items correctly (accurate CMDB ownership).
* Validate that deployed fixes actually mitigate the reported vulnerability, remove flagged/unnecessary software, and capture evidence for audit and closure.
* Maintain and report remediation status, backlog reduction and platform health metrics to the SCCM/APPPROXY lead and stakeholders.

  


**Coordination, Change \& War Room Operations**


* Liaise daily with the core SCCM/APPPROXY engineering team, SQL/DBA, platform, and service management to plan and execute patch windows.
* Raise and manage changes through EY change management (RFC / eCAB), including emergency/zero\-day changes, respecting change freezes and approvals.
* Provide War Room coverage during patch surges and zero\-day events: readiness checks, live execution, validation, rollback if thresholds are exceeded, and clear stakeholder communication.
* Produce concise, evidence\-based status updates and closure reports for leadership.

  


**Required Skills \& Experience**


* Hands\-on experience administering and patching SCCM/APPPROXY server infrastructure (CAS, Primary Sites, site system roles) in a large enterprise estate.
* Strong Windows Server administration skills (multi\-domain Active Directory) including patching, restart sequencing and post\-patch validation.
* Working knowledge of SQL Server as an SCCM/APPPROXY prerequisite — applying CU/GDR updates and understanding site\-database criticality and Always On / HA concepts.
* Solid understanding of enterprise change management (RFC / CAB / eCAB) and evidence/audit discipline.
* Ability to work under pressure in a War Room / on\-call model across accelerated and emergency patch cycles.

  


**Out of Scope**



To keep the role focused, the following are explicitly not the primary responsibility of this position:


* Day\-to\-day administration of the SCCM/APPPROXY application layer — application packaging/deployment, collections/targeting, task sequences, client health and end\-user device compliance.
* Operating\-system patching governance owned by other platform teams (the role executes/sequences server patching but does not own OS patch policy).

  


**EY \| Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

  

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

  


Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:

**Job description**
-------------------


Requisition ID: 1743824
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  



**MS Exchange Administrator**

  



Enterprise Technology provides reliable, secure and resilient technology services and solutions to support over 350,000 EY people. As part of Enterprise Technology, you’ll be at the forefront of enabling innovative technologies including emerging collaboration tools and world\-class technology infrastructure.

  



Our aim is to build an outstanding customer experience with clear investment in innovation, alongside operational excellence that delivers efficient, quality services and solutions. You will work with technologists and business specialists to meet the increasing pace of our business. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact.

  


**The opportunity**

  



Responsible for supporting and administering global Messaging and Directory services, with primary accountability for Microsoft Exchange Server On\-Premises patching, maintenance and related infrastructure activities.

  



The role also requires working knowledge of Exchange Online and hybrid Exchange to support end\-to\-end service operations, troubleshooting and coordination across the messaging environment.

  



This entails following ITIL methodologies and may include infrastructure maintenance, upgrades, migrations, vendor coordination, documentation, knowledge sharing and training of team members.

  


**Your key responsibilities**

  


* Microsoft Exchange Server On\-Premises administration and infrastructure support.
* Plan, coordinate and execute Microsoft Exchange Server On\-Premises patching activities, including Security Updates (SUs), Hotfix Updates (HUs), Cumulative Updates (CUs), Windows updates and required prerequisites.
* Review Microsoft security advisories, release notes, known issues, prerequisites and dependencies, and translate them into patch\-readiness assessments and implementation plans.
* Prepare Exchange servers for maintenance using approved procedures, including service health checks, Database Availability Group (DAG) and database validations, transport queue checks, load\-balancer coordination and server maintenance mode.
* Troubleshoot patch installation failures and post\-patching issues using Exchange setup and update logs, Windows event logs, PowerShell, HealthChecker output and other approved diagnostic tools.
* Create and manage change records, implementation plans, validation evidence, rollback plans, stakeholder communications and closure documentation in accordance with established change\-management processes.
* Coordinate patching across production and non\-production environments, including maintenance windows, shift coverage, technical bridge support, vendor engagement and escalation to Microsoft Support when required.
* Provide operational support for Exchange Online and hybrid Exchange, including recipient administration, connectors, accepted domains, mail flow, message tracing and escalation of cloud\-side issues.
* Share technical knowledge through operational documentation and classroom or hands\-on training.

  


**Skills and attributes for success**

  


* Strong ownership of Exchange Server On\-Premises patching in large, business\-critical environments.
* Methodical approach to patch assessment, risk identification, dependency validation, implementation, validation and rollback planning.
* Strong troubleshooting and root\-cause\-analysis skills across Exchange Server, Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, IIS, networking and load\-balancing dependencies.
* Ability to work effectively during critical maintenance windows, service\-impacting incidents and accelerated security\-patching activities.
* Strong attention to detail in change records, technical procedures, validation evidence, server inventories and compliance reporting.
* Ability to communicate technical risks, implementation status and service impact clearly to technical teams, service owners, vendors and leadership stakeholders.
* Strong teamwork, organization, prioritization and time\-management skills in a globally distributed and cross\-cultural environment.
* Continuous\-improvement mindset, with the ability to standardize patching processes and identify safe automation opportunities.
* Willingness to share knowledge and provide classroom or hands\-on training to team members.

  


**To qualify for the role, you must have**

  


* Seven or more years of hands\-on experience in Microsoft Exchange Server administration, including recent experience with Exchange Server 2016, 2019 and/or Subscription Edition.
* Demonstrated experience planning and executing Exchange Server On\-Premises patching across multiple servers, including SUs, HUs, CUs, Windows updates, prerequisites, reboot coordination and rollback readiness.
* Hands\-on experience with Exchange maintenance mode, DAGs, database copy health, transport queues, mail\-flow validation, certificates, virtual directories and post\-patching verification.
* Proficiency in Exchange Management Shell and Windows PowerShell for administration, remote health checks, validation, reporting and automation.
* Working knowledge of Exchange Online and hybrid Exchange, including recipient administration, connectors, accepted domains, mail flow, message tracing and Exchange Online PowerShell.
* Experience working within ITIL incident, problem and change\-management processes, including implementation planning, rollback planning, testing, evidence collection and closure.
* Experience supporting a large, highly available or geographically distributed Exchange environment and coordinating with infrastructure teams, monitoring teams, vendors and Microsoft Support.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills, sound judgment, cross\-cultural awareness and effective stakeholder\-management skills.
* Flexibility to support planned maintenance, night shifts, weekends and critical security\-patching windows when required.

  


**Technical skills to include:**

  


* Microsoft Exchange Server 2016, 2019 and Subscription Edition administration and troubleshooting.
* Exchange Security Update, Hotfix Update, Cumulative Update and Windows patch deployment.
* Patch\-readiness assessment, maintenance mode, pre\-patching and post\-patching validation, and rollback planning.
* Exchange DAGs, databases, database copy health, transport services, mail\-flow components, connectors, certificates, namespaces and virtual directories.
* Exchange Management Shell and Windows PowerShell for administration, automation, reporting and remote server health validation.
* Exchange HealthChecker, Exchange setup and update logs, Windows event logs, SCOM or equivalent monitoring tools.
* Working knowledge of Exchange Online and hybrid Exchange administration, troubleshooting and mail flow.

  


**Ideally, you’ll also have**

  


* Experience with Exchange HealthChecker, SCOM or equivalent monitoring platforms, load balancers and enterprise vulnerability management tools.
* Knowledge of Exchange high availability, backup, disaster recovery, site resilience, email security, archiving and retention.
* Experience improving or automating patching workflows, compliance reporting and post\-patching validation.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 security and compliance, Exchange Online Protection and Defender for Office 365\.
* Experience managing Exchange certificates, TLS configuration, namespaces and certificate\-renewal activities.
* Experience supporting Hybrid Configuration Wizard activities and troubleshooting hybrid mail flow and connectivity.
* Experience coordinating with Microsoft Support during critical patching or service\-restoration activities.

  


**What we look for**

  


* A technically strong Exchange On\-Premises administrator who can independently own patching activities from assessment and change planning through implementation, validation and evidence\-based closure.
* A reliable team member who works safely in a controlled enterprise environment, communicates risks early and collaborates effectively across global teams.
* Flexibility to work in night shifts or outside standard business hours when required for maintenance and critical security updates.

  


**What we offer**

  



As part of this role, you'll work in a highly integrated, globally diverse team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Here, you can combine global opportunity with flexible working. The EY benefits package goes above and beyond too, focusing on your physical, emotional, financial and social well\-being. Your recruiter can talk to you about the benefits available in your country. Here’s a snapshot of what we offer:

  


* **Continuous learning:** You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* **Success as defined by you:** We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a significant impact, your way.
* **Transformative leadership:** We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* **Diverse and inclusive culture**: You’ll be accepted for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
